2292-2317-6763-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

7084-7885-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

4452-5686-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-5686-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 3.

147-653-2292.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-2292.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2464-3249-5457--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-5457--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-5457--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1879-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1879-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1879-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2146-3532-5078-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4452-4508-7746.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4452-4508-7746.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as HYDRA Assault Robot is a Pirate due to Rukarumel, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1894-2092-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Bile Urchin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Bile Urchin, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

5170-6132-6772-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

283-2060-3197-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Herd Baloth
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve both Ghave abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

6798-7084-7396.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

539-3899-4552-5089-5902.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1315-1479-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-5702.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1680-3767-3918-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color] is at least three.
1680-3767-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color you have devotion to.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1789-5256-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-5256-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-2198-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2198-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Deceiver Exarch with haste.
When the token Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Deceiver Exarch.
Repeat.

2527-3143-3464-5686.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-3143-3464-5686.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

190-389-3629-5248.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
190-389-3629-5248.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Cloudsteel Kirin.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

2523-4050-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Ratadrabik of Urborg trigger, creating a nonlegendary copy of Ozox that is a 2/2 Zombie.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the Ozox token, adding {1}{B}.
Ratadrabik, Jumblejones and the Ozox token trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Jumblejones that is a 2/2 Zombie. 
Resolve the Jumblejones trigger, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ozox token's trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblejones creature token.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

499-2034-2820-5006.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {C}{C}.
When Lurrus dies, Angelic Renewal and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Angelic Renewal trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and return Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {1}, adding {W}.
Cast Angelic Renewal from your graveyard by paying {1}{W}.
Repeat.

3875-5413-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
3875-5413-5720-5721.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers that many times, creating a Treasure token for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite Treasure tokens and/or Food tokens due to Tireless Provisioner's trigger.

4396-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2249-4214-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2249-4214-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

2136-4050-4242-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Orthion.
2136-4050-4242-5200.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Su-Chi with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Su-Chi tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
When the Su-Chi tokens die, they trigger, adding twelve {C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature you control.

915-3525-4306.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Synod Artificer.
Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to blue is at least three.
915-3525-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.

2757-3644-5189.description:
Activate a basic land, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Young Wolf.
Young Wolf's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Ghave's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control besides Young Wolf.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Young Wolf, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Young Wolf, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Saproling creature token, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.
